faqs.question: What does an AI consultant do?
faqs.answer: An AI consultant helps assess opportunities, readiness, data, risks, and technology choices, then develops a roadmap for applying AI to business needs.

faqs.question: What kinds of AI consulting do you offer?
faqs.answer: Our work can include AI strategy, use case discovery, readiness assessment, data and architecture guidance, private AI planning, product strategy, and implementation support.

faqs.question: How do we know where AI can help our business?
faqs.answer: We review your goals and workflows with stakeholders, identify friction or opportunity, and assess candidate use cases by value, feasibility, risk, and readiness.

faqs.question: Can you help assess our AI readiness?
faqs.answer: Yes. A readiness review can cover data availability and quality, technology, skills, governance, security, and organizational needs.

faqs.question: Do you provide AI security and private AI consulting?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can advise on data protection, access controls, model choices, deployment options, and governance practices for sensitive AI use cases.

faqs.question: Will we receive a practical AI roadmap?
faqs.answer: The outcome can include prioritized use cases, recommended architecture, delivery phases, resource needs, key dependencies, and measures of success.

faqs.question: Can Kodrise also build the recommended AI solution?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consulting can continue into product design, engineering, integration, deployment, and ongoing support, depending on your needs.

faqs.question: How long does an AI consulting engagement take?
faqs.answer: A focused strategy or readiness assessment may take a few weeks. Broader roadmaps and implementation planning depend on the number of systems, teams, and use cases involved.

faqs.question: What should we prepare before an AI consultation?
faqs.answer: Bring your business goals, examples of current workflows, known data sources, constraints, and questions. We can help identify the rest during discovery.

faqs.question: Which industries do you advise?
faqs.answer: We work across sectors such as healthcare, finance, retail, logistics, manufacturing, education, real estate, and media, adapting recommendations to each organization.
